name: Taillcenn
text: Taillcenn and Taillkenn are corrupt spellings of Tálcend. Tálcend is the nickname the Fenian dialogues give to St Patrick. The word means adze-head. The pun touches his bishop's mitre and his hard-headed refusal to hear the pagan side.

attributes.attribute: St Patrick's nickname in the Fenian dialogues, meaning adze-head
